Highlights by Federal Reserve District 
Overall Economic Activity 
Most of the twelve Federal Reserve Districts reported that their economies continued to expand at a modest or moder-
ate pace from early April through late May. Boston and Chicago signaled that growth in their Districts had slowed 
somewhat to a modest pace since the prior Beige Book period, while New York indicated that activity had flattened out.
